title: Network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure initiation

entities.name: Network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reliable transport of EAP messages specific to network slices, initiated by AMF and involving timer T3575 per S-NSSAI.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to initiate network slice-specific EAP transport, containing EAP message IE and S-NSSAI IE.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: IE carrying EAP-request message generated by AMF or provided by AAA-S via NSSAAF.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing HPLMN S-NSSAI or SNPN S-NSSAI to which the EAP-request message is related.

entities.name: T3575
entities.description: Timer started by AMF per S-NSSAI when sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message if running.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that creates and sends NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and stops timer T3346.

relations.description: Procedure initiation involves creating and sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message contains EAP message IE.
NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message contains S-NSSAI IE.
AMF starts timer T3575 per S-NSSAI when sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
UE stops timer T3346 upon receipt of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message if running.
Receipt of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message triggers UE to stop T3346 and pass EAP message and S-NSSAI to upper layers.
